# KashTheKing's Library

Reusable Roblox building blocks, plugins, packages, and guides. Grab what you need!

**Documentation, guides and API reference: https://kashtheking.com/library/**

- **[Packages](packages)** - Source code for all of my distributed packages ([docs](https://kashtheking.com/library/docs/packages/), [API](https://kashtheking.com/library/api/))
- **[Plugins](plugins)** - My Roblox Studio plugins/plugin forks ([docs](https://kashtheking.com/library/docs/plugins/))
- **[Building Blocks](building-blocks)** - Fully-built systems and assets ([docs](https://kashtheking.com/library/docs/building-blocks/))
- **[Guides](guides)** - Full-explanation guides, tutorials, resources, and references ([docs](https://kashtheking.com/library/docs/guides/))

## Help and contact

- Discord: https://discord.gg/6HYgCk22eD
- Issues: https://github.com/KashTheKing/library/issues
- Email: kashtheking123@gmail.com
- @KashTheKing on [Roblox](https://www.roblox.com/users/117445502/profile), [X](https://x.com/KashTheKing_X) and [YouTube](https://youtube.com/@KashTheKingYT)

## The docs site

The site is built with [Moonwave](https://eryn.io/moonwave/) from `moonwave.toml`, `docs/`, `pages/` and the
doc comments in `packages/src`, the same setup as the [Infinite Ocean docs](https://kashtheking.com/infinite-ocean/).

```bash
npm install
npm run docs:dev       # preview at http://localhost:3000/library/
npm run docs:build     # static site in build/docs
npm run publish:docs   # build and commit into KashTheKing.github.io/library
```

Packages and building blocks are MIT licensed (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). Free plugins are licensed under FSL-1.1-ALv2 (the `LICENSE.md` in each plugin's folder); paid plugins are proprietary.
